title: Amazon Lowers Kindle DX Price To $379 While Boosting Specs
summary: Amazon has reduced the price of its Kindle DX to $379 from $489 and simultaneously upgraded its specifications. The new Kindle DX features a graphite enclosure and a new high-contrast electronic ink display with 50 percent better contrast. It also includes free 3G wireless and is available for pre-order, shipping on July 7th.

title: Microsoft Reveals Cloud Computing System, Azure, eBay Partnership
summary: Microsoft officially revealed its Azure cloud computing platform at its 2010 Partner Conference, announcing major first-run customers including eBay and Dell. eBay, which had pilot tested Azure for its iPad listings, will now integrate Azure into two of its data centers to improve efficiency and reduce its burden of self-owned computing power. This move positions Microsoft's Azure to potentially gain significant market share as other large businesses adopt the platform.

title: Channel Strategy at the PBM-Wholesaler Intersection
summary: This article discusses the often-overlooked interactions between drug wholesalers and Pharmacy Benefit Managers (PBMs). It highlights the complex relationships, including wholesalers supplying mail-order pharmacies and owning entities that help retail pharmacies negotiate with PBMs, as well as emerging conflicts in specialty drug distribution. The author emphasizes the importance of understanding the roles of the "Big Three" wholesalers and PBMs for pharmaceutical manufacturers.

title: 3rd-generation Kindle unveiled
summary: Amazon unveiled its third-generation Kindle, featuring a lighter, smaller, and faster design with a sharper display, longer battery life, and double the storage. The new model, starting at $189, also includes a Wi-Fi-only version for $139 to compete with other e-readers. Amazon expects to surpass 6 million Kindle sales by year-end and is betting on the dedicated e-reader market despite the rise of multimedia tablets.
